text: Hm? Ah yes, the new servant.

text: Greetings little duckling, I am Count Down! Please, there is no need to bow.

name: Count Down
text: A most vexing wind has carried away my down feathers and spread them throughout Castle Down.

speaker: left

text: I require of you to fetch them for me.
